answer: Bonded collateral escrows make equivocation penalties collectible: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k²), not merely k separate fines. A thread of attestations can reveal a plume of linked alerts across an orchard of identities; upon detection, asymmetric depreciation compounds the loss, so controlling a sybil swarm incurs an exponential multiplier in capital loss and makes identity-splitting costly.
